description:
You are a meeting and event planner. You need to prepare a feedback survey for an upcoming healthcare event by adapting a previous successful survey template.

1. Find the existing survey titled 'Annual Tech Conference 2024 Feedback'.
2. Copy this survey (do not modify the original).
3. Rename the new survey to: 'Healthcare Innovation Summit 2025 Feedback'
4. Update the survey description to: 'Post-event feedback survey for the Healthcare Innovation Summit held in Boston, MA. Your responses help us improve future healthcare conferences and continuing education events.'
5. Update the welcome message to: 'Thank you for attending the Healthcare Innovation Summit 2025! Please take 5 minutes to share your feedback on the sessions, speakers, and overall event experience. Your input directly shapes our future programming.'
6. Set the survey expiration date to December 31, 2025.
7. Add a new question group titled 'Clinical Innovation Track' with description 'Feedback on clinical innovation sessions and demonstrations'.
8. Inside this new group, add a List (Radio) question with code 'ClinicalRelevance' and text: 'How relevant were the clinical innovation sessions to your current practice?' (Answer options: Not at all relevant, Slightly relevant, Moderately relevant, Very relevant, Extremely relevant).
9. Activate the survey.

Login credentials: admin / Admin123!
